structuredOutput.label: Structured Output
structuredOutput.description: Report your final answer. Call this exactly once, with the complete result, and put everything the caller needs inside the arguments — text written outside this call is discarded. If a call is rejected for not matching the schema, fix the reported fields and call it again.
structuredOutput.snippet: Report your final answer as structured data
structuredOutput.guideline: Your final answer MUST be reported by calling {tool}. Prose outside that call is discarded.
structuredOutput.retryInvalid: Your last {tool} call did not match the required schema: {error}
structuredOutput.retryMissing: You did not call {tool}, so your answer was not recorded.
structuredOutput.retry:
{reason}

Call {tool} now with your complete final answer. Do not reply with prose.

jsonSchema.objectRequired: agent() opts.schema must be a JSON Schema object.
jsonSchema.objectRootRequired: agent() opts.schema must have `type: "object"` at its root — it becomes the tool's input schema, and a non-object root is not something a model can be asked to fill.
jsonSchema.tooLarge: agent() opts.schema is too large ({size} bytes; the limit is {limit}).
jsonSchema.unsupported: agent() opts.schema is not a schema this runtime can validate: {error}
jsonSchema.validationFailed: the value could not be validated: {error}
jsonSchema.mismatch: the value does not match the required schema
jsonSchema.validation.anyOf: must match a schema in anyOf
jsonSchema.validation.contains: must contain at least 1 valid item
jsonSchema.validation.dependencies: must have properties {dependencies} when property {property} is present
jsonSchema.validation.enum: must be equal to one of the allowed values
jsonSchema.validation.maxItems: must not have more than {limit} items
jsonSchema.validation.maxLength: must not have more than {limit} characters
jsonSchema.validation.maxProperties: must not have more than {limit} properties
jsonSchema.validation.minItems: must not have fewer than {limit} items
jsonSchema.validation.minLength: must not have fewer than {limit} characters
jsonSchema.validation.minProperties: must not have fewer than {limit} properties
jsonSchema.validation.oneOf: must match exactly one schema in oneOf
